typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		cluster as string,
		esx_hosts as string,
		v_center as string,
		esx_host_ip as string,
		OS_VERSION as string,
		MANUFACTURER as string,
		MODEL_NAME as string,
		model_number as string,
		ESXi8_compatible as string,
		ENV as string,
		datacenter_normalized as string,
		vm_name as string,
		{Power Status} as string,
		vm_ip as string,
		subnet as string,
		Restrictions as string,
		vm_guest_network as string,
		vLAN_ID as string,
		{Rep Start Date} as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		{Rep End Date} as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		{Cutover Date} as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		{Tunnel Closure Date} as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		RAM as double,
		CPU_CORE as double,
		DEVICE_SYS_CLASS_DESC as string,
		ENVIRONMENT_DESCRIPTION as string,
		MODEL_NAME1 as string,
		primary_record as double,
		app_id as string,
		APPLICATION_NAME as string,
		LINE_OF_BUSINESS as string,
		CIO as string,
		PAA_INDICATOR as string,
		PRIMARY_APP_DISTRIBUTED_ID as string,
		db_app_id as string,
		DBMS as string,
		DATABASE_NAME as string,
		DATABASE_SIZE as string,
		{DB Data Migrated Y/N} as string,
		{Replication CR} as string,
		{CutOver CR} as string,
		{Tunnel Closure CR} as string,
		{Replication Status} as string,
		{Cutover Status} as string,
		Scope as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource
ExcelSource derive(ImportDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		cluster as string,
		subnet as string,
		Replication_CR as string,
		esx_hosts as string,
		ESXi8_compatible as string,
		ENV as string,
		Cutover_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CutOver_CR as string,
		Rep_End_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DB_Data_Migrated_Y_N as string,
		v_center as string,
		Power_Status as string,
		datacenter_normalized as string,
		ENVIRONMENT_DESCRIPTION as string,
		db_app_id as string,
		LINE_OF_BUSINESS as string,
		PRIMARY_APP_DISTRIBUTED_ID as string,
		model_number as string,
		app_id as string,
		APPLICATION_NAME as string,
		vm_name as string,
		vm_ip as string,
		Restrictions as string,
		vLAN_ID as string,
		primary_record as double,
		Replication_Status as string,
		MODEL_NAME1 as string,
		MODEL_NAME as string,
		DATABASE_NAME as string,
		Cutover_Status as string,
		ImportDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Rep_Start_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PAA_INDICATOR as string,
		CIO as string,
		DATABASE_SIZE as string,
		Tunnel_Closure_CR as string,
		MANUFACTURER as string,
		esx_host_ip as string,
		CPU_CORE as double,
		Scope as string,
		vm_guest_network as string,
		OS_VERSION as string,
		DBMS as string,
		Tunnel_Closure_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DEVICE_SYS_CLASS_DESC as string,
		RAM as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		cluster,
		subnet,
		Replication_CR = {Replication CR},
		esx_hosts,
		ESXi8_compatible,
		ENV,
		Cutover_Date = {Cutover Date},
		CutOver_CR = {CutOver CR},
		Rep_End_Date = {Rep End Date},
		DB_Data_Migrated_Y_N = {DB Data Migrated Y/N},
		v_center,
		Power_Status = {Power Status},
		datacenter_normalized,
		ENVIRONMENT_DESCRIPTION,
		db_app_id,
		LINE_OF_BUSINESS,
		PRIMARY_APP_DISTRIBUTED_ID,
		model_number,
		app_id,
		APPLICATION_NAME,
		vm_name,
		vm_ip,
		Restrictions,
		vLAN_ID,
		primary_record,
		Replication_Status = {Replication Status},
		MODEL_NAME1,
		MODEL_NAME,
		DATABASE_NAME,
		Cutover_Status = {Cutover Status},
		ImportDate,
		Rep_Start_Date = {Rep Start Date},
		PAA_INDICATOR,
		CIO,
		DATABASE_SIZE,
		Tunnel_Closure_CR = {Tunnel Closure CR},
		MANUFACTURER,
		esx_host_ip,
		CPU_CORE,
		Scope,
		vm_guest_network,
		OS_VERSION,
		DBMS,
		Tunnel_Closure_Date = {Tunnel Closure Date},
		DEVICE_SYS_CLASS_DESC,
		RAM),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
